ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottle is concentrated on the distal-posterior quadrant of the right lobe. Discrete circular white clusters are scattered across the medial dark fields of both lobes. The left lobe distal tip shows minor white banding along the lateral edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated obtuse angle of approximately 120 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits an irregular, jagged sawtooth topography with significantly higher pixel-amplitude variations and larger gaps between peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the central notch, terminating in distinct, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) are visible, primarily distributed across the dark-pigmented central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, vertically-oriented white linear streaks are detected on the medial section of the right lobe, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip compared to the relatively uniform edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a large white patch on the right distal lobe that is absent on the left lobe.
